decisions.reason: The aloe vera facial care line fits the firm's natural, gentle skincare positioning very well and its dedicated webpage suggests a meaningful commitment worth continuing in a growing market.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a close-to-core, high-demand facial care product that complements the existing range and is likely worth keeping after only one year on the market.
The facial cleansing milk matches the firm's promise of mild, simple, tolerable care and helps offer a complete facial routine, so dropping it this early would be premature.
